selection: Same eight previously exposed development histories as spatial-transport; no new observation, physical state, holdout or closed-loop rollout.
comparison: Primary: hybrid_equal versus physical_mixture at equal total endpoint-parameter operation budget. Controls: prior_qmc and response_chart. Hybrid has 20% uniform, 40% projected physical Gaussians and 40% response Gaussians. All proposal settings inherited unchanged; no sweep or post-result tuning.
accounting: Charge pilot, all finite-difference/projection physics, fresh preparation/prefix replay, and every future branch. No shared physics cache across histories, replicas or methods. Nested lower-budget estimates reuse maximum-run prefixes but are each charged full setup; time measured only for each maximum-budget run. Budget counts scalar parameter/end-step solves, not CPU time, vectorized calls, proposal density arithmetic or memory.
stopping: Preallocate K=floor((budget-setup_cost)/full_path_cost) inside-cube physical evaluations. Stop proposal stream at K-th inside-cube draw, independent of likelihood/future outputs. Whole-mixture cube-conditioning contributes one common normalizer which cancels in self-normalized weights; no evidence estimate. Outside draws retain zero target weight and count as draws, with no physics cost. No component-wise clipping or rejection normalization.
scope: Empirical sampling/budget development diagnostic under the same known fixed-64-increment synthetic law. No validated posterior reference, safety bound, policy benefit, learned world model, Gaussian-image result or novelty claim.
